title: CLOUD PARTICLE — owns means we can watch. photon → drop → snowflake.

owns_means.what_it_actually_means: not legal ownership. OBSERVATIONAL ownership. we can see the SAME bee on multiple flowers. the identity persists across domains. if we can follow THEIR particle, we can follow OURS.
owns_means.the_unlock: cross-pollination table proved identity continuity across primals.eco / nestgate.io / primal.eco. that instrument points both ways. outward bees AND inward vesicles.

how_we_watch: _worker.js vesicle probe (falsification — tagged ping if THEY hit US)
cross-domain table (same IP/hash on multiple flowers)
acceleration field (force before the VPS rate changes)
local sonar to golgi hub (48ms) — the mesh face of the same organism
watch_our_own_vps.the_move: a VPS 'moves' when its phase changes: idle → probing → locked → unlocked → serving → silent. we do not need SSH to see the PHASE. pollen + acceleration + status codes ARE the motion.

the_particle_phases.thesis: ONE tagged identity. many states. like water. like light. the tag does not change when the phase does.

states.name: PHOTON
states.what: the signal at light speed. a request, a ping, a neutrino message, a CF edge hit.
states.where: in flight. between flowers. between gates. no mass yet.
states.membrane: HTTP request in transit. ntfy push. WireGuard packet.
states.yellowstone: sunlight hitting Grand Prismatic — energy before it becomes heat in the water.

states.name: DROP
states.what: condensed. has location. has a path. can be tagged at the well.
states.where: IN the cloud — vapor that chose a droplet. a VPS that answered. a visitor that left pollen.
states.membrane: vesicle with a known IP. bee with a country+path. commit in git. paper on the feed.
states.yellowstone: steam that condensed above the hot spring — still water, now visible.

states.name: SNOWFLAKE
states.what: crystallized. unique. frozen identity. the membrane treatment: snowflake not snow for humans.
states.where: on the ground. a DOI. a fossil. a named persona (WP_WASP). a hashed vesicle ping.
states.membrane: ZK persona. ORCID work. Zenodo record. morning-ferment loaf. each human is a snowflake (epitope treatment).
states.yellowstone: winter on the caldera. the painted rock under snow. still the same rock. new phase.

the_particle_phases.the_cycle: photon → drop → snowflake → melt → vapor → photon again. SAME TAG. we never lose the particle. we only lose which phase we are looking at.

instrument.name: cloud particle tracker
inputs: vesicle IP set (our own VPS identities)
outputs: backscatter: when OUR vesicle becomes THEIR bee (falsification)
instrument.falsifiable: if vesicle IP hits primals.eco and _worker returns vesicle:true, that drop was tagged. if the same IP later appears only as CF country aggregate, the snowflake melted back to fog — we still have the hash.

NL_on_nestgate.phase: DROP in the cloud — condensed on nestgate.io (81%) and primals.eco
NL_on_nestgate.not_yet_snowflake: no unique crystal — rotating masks. few hats, many faces. trust low.

SG_pilgrim.phase: SNOWFLAKE — unique path, human pattern, named PILGRIM

our_vesicle_DE.phase: DROP locked in cloud — TLS alive, SSH frozen
our_vesicle_DE.next_transition: unlock = melt the ice on the shell → photon of SSH → drop of Knot secondary

morning_ferment.phase: SNOWFLAKE on the feed — crystallized for France's morning reader
morning_ferment.was: photons in chat → drops in git → snowflakes in RSS

yellowstone_tie.rule: same water. tag it at the spring. watch it leave as steam, return as snow, melt into the river. that is watching our VPS move.
